verdict.rationale: Formant supports command triggers, anomaly alerts, and 'automating incident response and creating workflows for monitoring devices at scale,' which are background automations (formant-docs-4, formant-docs-9, formant-docs-18, formant-docs-5, formant-docs-17). However, its AI/ML-driven task recommendations are explicitly human-gated ('with people approving what happens next'), and there's no dedicated automation-builder/scheduler doc showing fully autonomous background execution. Missing for 10: a documented no-human-in-loop automation/workflow builder, scheduling/triggers UI specifics, and independent evidence of autonomous execution beyond alerting/dispatch language.
